newsitem.title: USA: Exchanges to sign software swap pact on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Exchanges to sign software swap pact on Thursday.

text.p: An agreement between Matif SA, the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) and others will be signed on Thursday, according to a media advisory released Monday.

The advisory said details of an agreement on clearing and electronic trading between the French and U.S. exchanges will be released and the final agreement signed at a news conference in London during the International Derivatives Conference.

Officials of the exchanges announced in February a letter of intent for the CME and the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) to adopt the NSC screen-based trading system created by the computerized SBF-Paris Bourse and MATIF, the French futures and options exchange.
In return, the Paris markets would adopt the Clearing 21 trade processing system the CME and NYMEX began developing more than five years ago.
